text: In 1971, a staff member of Caldwell Parish Library in Louisiana painted a diaper over the nude boy in Maurice Sendak's In the Night Kitchen because she believed people in the community would object to the illustration. In 1985, the book was challenged at Cunningham Elementary School in Beloit, WI, because it was believed to desensitize children to nudity. In 2022, Llano County (TX) Commissioners forced the library system to remove it from circulation.
meta_description: In the Night Kitchen by Maurice Sendak: painted over at a Louisiana library in 1971, challenged in Beloit in 1985, removed in Llano County in 2022.
